detail.title: Intex 43” Full HD Smart TV | LED-SFFV4312
detail.overview: The Intex LED-SFFV4312 43-inch Smart TV brings stunning visuals and powerful audio to your living space. With a Full HD frameless display and supreme 12W x 2 box speakers, every scene comes to life with crisp details and immersive sound. Powered by a Quad-Core A53 processor and Mali-G31 MP2 GPU, this TV ensures smooth performance, while Android 11.0 (AOSP) gives you access to a world of entertainment. Enjoy seamless connectivity with built-in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth audio, and multiple HDMI & USB ports. Smart features like voice assistant and screen mirroring enhance your viewing experience. Upgrade to smarter entertainment today!
features: 43-inch Full HD display with 1920 x 1080 resolution
Frameless design for an immersive experience
Powerful 12W x 2 box speakers with supreme sound
Android 11.0 (AOSP) for a smart and smooth experience
Quad-Core A53 CPU & Mali-G31 MP2 GPU for fast performance
1GB RAM & 8GB storage for seamless app usage
Built-in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth audio input/output & voice assistant
Smart screen mirroring with Kindlink & Maxhub Share
Connectivity: 2 HDMI, 2 USB, 2 AV input, Ethernet, headphone out
Certified Cloud TV with ADSIP technology
